svg.desc: The training step: batch, forward in train mode, loss, zero_grad and backward, gradient clipping, optimizer and scheduler step, then the next batch. A full checkpoint stores model, optimizer moments, scheduler, all RNG states and the epoch, so resume is bitwise exact; a weights-only checkpoint restarts warmup with empty Adam moments and a new shuffle.
